question: How big is English poem description of the painting dataset?
title: Prose for a Painting
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents discuss datasets used for generating English poems from images and for style transfer to Shakespearean prose, but none provide specific information about the size of the 'English poem description of the painting dataset'.
